claim_or_pattern: Workflows follow predefined paths while agents dynamically direct process and tools; start with the simplest adequate design.
notes: Evidence summary; supports execution-form distinctions, not task prevalence or Upgradeable efficacy.

source: A2 OpenAI A practical guide to building agents https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/
claim_or_pattern: Agents manage workflows with tools and guardrails; data tools and action tools have different functions and risks.
notes: Evidence summary; product guidance generalized only at the control-pattern level.

claim_or_pattern: General-assistant questions can combine reasoning, web browsing, multimodal handling, and tool use while retaining verifiable answers.
notes: Benchmark inclusion shows a capability bundle, not real-world prevalence.

claim_or_pattern: Multi-turn agents are evaluated across eight interactive environments; reported obstacles include long-term reasoning, decision-making, and instruction following.
notes: Evidence is bounded to benchmark environments.

claim_or_pattern: Parallel workers help breadth-heavy independent research, while vague delegation causes duplicate work and gaps.
notes: Evidence supports conditional orchestration and explicit worker boundaries.

source: A6 Anthropic Trustworthy agents in practice https://www.anthropic.com/research/trustworthy-agents
claim_or_pattern: Agent loops plan, act, observe, and adjust under principles of human control, transparency, security, and privacy.
notes: Evidence summary; not a complete safety policy.

claim_or_pattern: Issue resolution can require repository understanding, coordinated multi-file edits, execution environments, and long context.
notes: Benchmark tasks do not cover all software engineering.

claim_or_pattern: Repository-level completion separates cross-file retrieval, completion, and the integrated pipeline.
notes: Supports separating retrieval from change execution.

claim_or_pattern: Human review found underspecified issues and tests that could reject valid solutions, motivating a screened subset.
notes: Evidence supports treating specification and oracle fitness separately.

claim_or_pattern: Contamination and flawed tasks can make a benchmark unsuitable for measuring frontier capability even when the workflow remains relevant.
notes: Do not infer arbitrary production ability from benchmark scores.

source: B5 Anthropic Claude Code best practices https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/claude-code-best-practices
claim_or_pattern: Explore-plan-code-commit and test-first loops separate understanding, implementation, and verification; project instructions provide commands and conventions.
notes: Guidance supplies workflow patterns, not mandatory phases for trivial edits.

claim_or_pattern: Common issue-solving operations include reproducing, localizing, editing, and verifying.
notes: Supports phase modeling rather than one monolithic coding category.

source: B7 GitHub Copilot task best practices https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/using-github-copilot/using-copilot-coding-agent-to-work-on-tasks/best-practices-for-using-copilot-to-work-on-tasks
claim_or_pattern: Delegated coding works better with a clear problem, acceptance criteria, and scope; broad, sensitive, or ambiguous tasks need more care.
notes: Product guidance generalized as task-scoping signals.

claim_or_pattern: Automated code review may miss defects or produce false positives and should be validated and supplemented with human review.
notes: Supports review as a separate normally read-only task.

source: B9 GitHub Copilot Agents application card https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/responsible-use/agents
claim_or_pattern: Generated code and review findings require testing, security review, and human oversight before merge.
notes: Evidence concerns platform limitations and responsible use.

claim_or_pattern: Branch, credential, invocation, and merge constraints reduce the reach of coding-agent actions.
notes: Capability and permission remain separate from user authority.

claim_or_pattern: Open-ended research can require iterative search, source interpretation, synthesis, and course changes, with remaining source and citation risks.
notes: Evidence supports open investigation as distinct from direct lookup.

claim_or_pattern: Independent breadth-first searches can benefit from parallel workers but cost more tokens and fit poorly when context is tightly coupled.
notes: Supports conditional L5 research only for separable breadth.

claim_or_pattern: Hard-to-find factual retrieval can require searching many sites while targeting short stable verifiable answers.
notes: A lookup benchmark is not an ontology for synthesis or literature review.

claim_or_pattern: Browser-assisted long-form QA collected references during browsing to support later factual evaluation.
notes: Supports preserving source pointers during retrieval.

claim_or_pattern: Retrieval can improve knowledge-intensive generation in studied settings compared with a parametric-only baseline.
notes: Does not establish universal retrieval benefit or corpus quality.

claim_or_pattern: Claim verification includes supported, refuted, and not-enough-information outcomes tied to evidence.
notes: Supports a legitimate insufficient-evidence state.

claim_or_pattern: Research-paper QA may require evidence distributed across several document sections.
notes: Single-document does not necessarily mean simple.

claim_or_pattern: Citation correctness, citation completeness, answer correctness, and fluency are separable; more passages did not automatically improve results.
notes: Supports claim-level citation checks and bounded retrieval.

claim_or_pattern: Systematic reviews use explicit methods for search, selection, appraisal, synthesis, and reporting.
notes: Supports reserving systematic review for explicit protocol signals.

claim_or_pattern: Information-seeking can combine reasoning, browsing, multimodal input, and tools even when the requested answer is short.
notes: Complexity depends on evidence path, not answer length alone.

source: D1 Lost in the Middle https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172
claim_or_pattern: Use of relevant information varies with its position in long inputs; material in the middle can be used less reliably.
notes: Fitting in a context window does not establish reliable use.

claim_or_pattern: Long-context evaluation spans QA, summarization, few-shot learning, retrieval, and code completion, with degradation as context grows.
notes: Supports long context as a modifier, not one task archetype.

claim_or_pattern: Effective context performance can be below advertised window size and degrade with distractors, hops, chains, and aggregation demands.
notes: Simple needle retrieval is not a complete long-context validator.

claim_or_pattern: Additional retrieved passages do not automatically improve answer or citation quality; compressed passages may need source rehydration.
notes: Supports progressive loading with retained source pointers.

claim_or_pattern: Context is finite; small high-signal working sets, just-in-time retrieval, and compaction support long-horizon work.
notes: Engineering observation; not a guarantee for all models or tasks.

source: D6 Anthropic Effective harnesses for long-running agents https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-harnesses-for-long-running-agents
claim_or_pattern: Compaction alone did not prevent partial work or premature completion; explicit requirements, progress artifacts, and clean session boundaries were used.
notes: Supports explicit durable progress state.

source: D7 OpenAI computer environment for Responses API https://openai.com/index/equip-responses-api-computer-environment/
claim_or_pattern: Bounded tool output, compaction, and filesystem staging allow targeted retrieval instead of prompt-wide ingestion.
notes: Supports disposable active context plus explicit project artifacts.

claim_or_pattern: Explicit memory tiers move information between limited active context and external storage for long documents and sessions.
notes: Supports explicit storage/retrieval paths, not hidden-memory claims.

claim_or_pattern: Repository completion separates cross-file retrieval from generation.
notes: A project profile must not cause indiscriminate code ingestion.

claim_or_pattern: Issue resolution may coordinate code, tests, and environment state across large project context.
notes: Current issue still determines the working set.

claim_or_pattern: Saved plans, retries, and checkpoints support resumable work; tightly coupled shared-context tasks are a poor multi-agent fit.
notes: Supports explicit ownership and penalizing shared-context orchestration.

claim_or_pattern: Tool-using loops need environmental observations, stopping conditions, and well-described tool interfaces.
notes: Supports simple composable loops before autonomy.

source: E2 Anthropic Trustworthy agents in practice https://www.anthropic.com/research/trustworthy-agents
claim_or_pattern: Permissions can vary by action and many-step work may use plan review to reduce approval fatigue.
notes: Product patterns generalized at the control level.

source: E3 OpenAI A practical guide to building agents https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/
claim_or_pattern: Tool risk differs by read/write status, reversibility, permissions, and impact; high-risk actions and repeated failure warrant intervention.
notes: Supports risk-tiered controls.

source: E4 OpenAI Agents SDK human in the loop https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/human_in_the_loop/
claim_or_pattern: Approval can bind to a concrete tool call and arguments, interrupt execution, serialize state, and resume after approval or rejection.
notes: Implementation evidence for call-specific approval and resumability.

claim_or_pattern: Tool metadata can describe read-only, destructive, idempotent, and open-world properties, but untrusted annotations are hints.
notes: Unknown metadata must not be treated as safe.

claim_or_pattern: Authentication, scopes, audience validation, and protected-resource discovery constrain access to MCP resources.
notes: Task authority remains a repository synthesis distinction.

claim_or_pattern: Read-only defaults and declared safe output surfaces bound automated workflow reach.
notes: Evidence concerns a specific platform control design.

claim_or_pattern: Restricted branches and credentials plus human merge review layer defenses around agent changes.
notes: Supports narrow write surfaces and review, not general safety proof.

claim_or_pattern: Automatic retry is safe only for idempotent operations or when the client knows the original non-idempotent request was not applied.
notes: HTTP semantics generalized only to the retry-safety principle.

claim_or_pattern: Formal planning can be evaluated through action preconditions, effects, goal reachability, and plan validity.
notes: Supports explicit planning state rather than generic long-form output.

claim_or_pattern: Real-world planning combines information gathering, tool use, commonsense, and multiple explicit constraints; agents can lose task and constraints.
notes: Evidence is bounded to travel-planning tasks.

claim_or_pattern: Search over candidate reasoning states with evaluation, lookahead, and backtracking can help tasks with consequential early choices.
notes: Supports conditional branching, not universal tree search.

claim_or_pattern: Workflow complexity and parallelism should be added only when task structure and benefit justify latency and cost.
notes: Supports complexity ceilings and conditional parallelism.

claim_or_pattern: Generate-feedback-refine loops improved outputs in studied generation and reasoning tasks without added training.
notes: Does not establish independent validation because one model supplies feedback.

claim_or_pattern: Tool-grounded critique can support correction; self-verification without reliable external feedback can be inefficient or unreliable.
notes: Supports external or deterministic checks when available.

claim_or_pattern: Logic-grid accuracy declines as controllable constraint-search complexity grows, including with increased inference compute.
notes: Benchmark does not imply every reasoning task needs search.

claim_or_pattern: Constraint feasibility and solver-proven optimality can diverge and should be evaluated separately.
notes: Supports feasibility checks before ranking.

claim_or_pattern: Multi-hop spatial reasoning requires robust relation composition despite varied language and distractors.
notes: Supports explicit relational state and inverse checks.

claim_or_pattern: Divergent association and creative writing measure forms of originality and diversity distinct from ordinary correctness.
notes: One creativity test does not establish a general creative faculty.

claim_or_pattern: Models that solve complete problems may still fail to identify the minimal question needed for an underspecified problem.
notes: Supports clarification as a reasoning outcome.

claim_or_pattern: Risk controls should reflect context and risk tolerance; task scope, knowledge limits, oversight, impacts, and error costs should be documented.
notes: Framework guidance; not domain policy or Upgradeable efficacy evidence.

claim_or_pattern: Organizations should select risk-management practices appropriate to their context rather than apply one universal checklist.
notes: Supports proportional controls.

source: G3 NIST Generative AI Profile https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.600-1
claim_or_pattern: Capability claims, sources, citations, incidents, overrides, recovery, and escalation need documented evaluation and management.
notes: Control guidance, not a substantive answer policy.

source: G4 GAO AI Accountability Framework https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-21-519sp
claim_or_pattern: Governance, data, performance against objectives, and monitoring are complementary accountability areas.
notes: Supports multi-dimensional assurance rather than one metric.

claim_or_pattern: Uncertainty disclosure should reflect uncertainty and the impact of error, including knowledge, recency, intent, world, and prediction uncertainty.
notes: Supports qualitative uncertainty states rather than invented probabilities.

source: G6 OpenAI A practical guide to building agents https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/
claim_or_pattern: Sensitive, irreversible, or high-stakes actions and exceeded failure thresholds warrant human intervention.
notes: Approval and correctness validation remain separate.

claim_or_pattern: A Skill is a directory with required metadata and instructions plus optional scripts, references, and assets; progressive disclosure limits context load.
notes: Supports the package form; does not prove task performance.

claim_or_pattern: Clients can disclose compact Skill metadata first and load the full Skill only when the task matches.
notes: Supports just-in-time loading and location-based references.

claim_or_pattern: Skills package instructions, scripts, and resources for repeatable specialized tasks and can live at project or personal scope.
notes: Platform paths vary; core identity should remain portable.

source: H4 GitHub Copilot customization cheat sheet https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/customization-cheat-sheet
claim_or_pattern: Custom instructions, prompts, agents, subagents, Skills, hooks, and MCP servers are separate customization forms.
notes: Supports packaging distinctions.

claim_or_pattern: MCP distinguishes user-controlled prompts, application-controlled resources, and model-controlled tools.
notes: Supports choosing packages by missing capability.

source: H6 GitHub custom agents and subagent orchestration https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-sdk/features/custom-agents
claim_or_pattern: Custom agents have their own prompts and tool scopes; subagents execute delegated work in isolated context and return results.
notes: Supports agent thresholds beyond repetition alone.

source: H7 OpenAI A practical guide to building agents https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/
claim_or_pattern: A single agent with tools is often sufficient; multi-agent manager and handoff patterns add separation with overhead.
notes: Supports selecting the least complex form.

claim_or_pattern: Subagents fit parallel or isolated independent work but can be excessive for simple, sequential, or tightly shared-context tasks.
notes: Supports conditional delegation.

source: H9 Agent Skills creator best practices https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/best-practices
claim_or_pattern: Overly comprehensive Skills can distract; concise procedures and conditionally loaded focused references support progressive disclosure.
notes: Supports token and scope budgets.

claim_or_pattern: Skills package procedural knowledge, scripts, and resources into discoverable composable task-specific folders.
notes: Supports Skill composition, not automatic conversion of every task.
